English:
We are advising all health workers to ensure they are wearing masks and PPEs at all times. 
Please take all the measures we have announced seriously.
Kiswahili:
Tunawashauri wafanyakazi wote wa afya kuhakikisha wamevaa barakoa na vifaa vya kujikinga wakati wote.

Tafadhali chukua hatua zote ambazo tumetangaza kwa uzito.

English:
We are advising members of the public to put on masks when getting into a matatu one is advised to put on a mask.
Local production of masks and PPEs has began
Kiswahili:
Tunawashauri wananchi kuvaa barakoa wanapoingia kwenye matatu, mtu anashauriwa kuvaa barakoa.

Uzalishaji wa barakoa na vifaa vya kujikinga umeanza.

English:
This are the first steps to keeping your family safe from Covid 19;
1.Wash your hands regularly with soap & running water
2. Cover your mouth and nose with a flexed elbow or tissue, when coughing or sneezing.
3.Avoid close contact with anyone who has cold or flu-like symptoms
Kiswahili:
Hizi ni hatua za kwanza za kulinda familia yako kutokana na Covid 19;
1. Osha mikono yako mara kwa mara kwa sabuni na maji yanayotiririka
2. Funika mdomo na pua yako kwa kiwiko au tishu iliyokunjwa, unapokohoa au kupiga chafya.
3. Epuka kugusana kwa karibu na mtu yeyote ambaye ana dalili za mafua au mafua.

English: Alcohol and Smoking will increase the risks of having high blood pressure. While you STAY AT HOME reduce alcohol intake and smoking.
Kiswahili: Pombe na Uvutaji Sigara vitaongeza hatari za kuwa na shinikizo la damu. Unapokaa NYUMBANI punguza unywaji wa pombe na uvutaji sigara.

English:
Be safe from coronavirus.Washing your hands is the most important way to stop transmission.
1.Wet hands
2.Apply enough soap
3.Scrub all surfaces of the hands for 20-30 seconds.
4.Rinse thoroughly with running water
5.Dry hands with a clean cloth or single-use towel
Kiswahili:
Kuwa salama kutokana na virusi vya corona. Kuosha mikono yako ndiyo njia muhimu zaidi ya kuzuia maambukizi.

1. Lowesha mikono
2. Paka sabuni ya kutosha
3. Sugua sehemu zote za mikono kwa sekunde 20-30.

4. Suuza vizuri na maji yanayotiririka
5. Kausha mikono kwa kitambaa safi au taulo ya matumizi moja

English:
How to boost your immune system against the COVID-19;
1. Stay hydrated - drink 3-4 litres of water daily.
2. Take antioxidant-rich diet - amla, guava, green leafy veggies, spinach, garlic, green tea, peppers, turmeric
3. Exercise
4. Meditation
5. Quality sleep
Kiswahili:
Jinsi ya kuimarisha kinga yako dhidi ya COVID-19;
1. Endelea kuwa na maji mwilini - kunywa lita 3-4 za maji kila siku.
2. Chukua lishe yenye vioksidishaji vingi - amla, guava, mboga za majani mabichi, mchicha, kitunguu saumu, chai ya kijani, pilipili hoho, manjano
3. Mazoezi
4. Kutafakari
5. Usingizi bora

English: You have to be registered to get the COVID-19 vaccine.  You can do this at the nearest health facility or be registering on the MOH_Kenya website (http://health.go.ke). All you need is your ID card. Kindly assist your elderly relatives to get registered
Kiswahili: Lazima uwe umesajiliwa ili kupata chanjo ya COVID-19. Unaweza kufanya hivi katika kituo cha afya kilicho karibu au kujiandikisha kwenye tovuti ya MOH_Kenya (http://health.go.ke). Unachohitaji ni kitambulisho chako. Tafadhali wasaidie jamaa zako wazee kujiandikisha.

English: Health CS Mutahi Kagwe says total lockdown on the table if coronavirus cases escalate, urges Kenyans to limit social interactions.
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Afya Mutahi Kagwe anasema amri ya kutotoka nje ikiwa visa vya virusi vya corona vitaongezeka, anawahimiza Wakenya kupunguza mwingiliano wa kijamii.

English: Covid-19 variant from India detected in Kenya, MoH says the case was reported in Kisumu.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inasema kisa hicho kiliripotiwa Kisumu, aina ya Covid-19 kutoka India ikigunduliwa nchini Kenya.

English: A small number of vaccinated people may get infected with COVID-19 after vaccination; this is called a breakthrough infection, but they are likely to have milder symptoms than if they were not vaccinated.
Kiswahili: Idadi ndogo ya watu waliochanjwa wanaweza kuambukizwa COVID-19 baada ya chanjo; hii inaitwa maambukizi ya mafanikio, lakini kuna uwezekano wa kuwa na dalili ndogo kuliko kama hawakuchanjwa.

English: All COVID-19 vaccines are safe for use by adults, breastfeeding mothers and as per current WHO guidelines, can also be used by pregnant women upon recommendation by a qualified physician.
Kiswahili: Chanjo zote za COVID-19 ni salama kwa matumizi ya watu wazima, akina mama wanaonyonyesha na kulingana na miongozo ya sasa ya WHO, zinaweza pia kutumiwa na wanawake wajawazito kwa mapendekezo ya daktari aliyehitimu.

English: Taking different types of vaccines is not recommended. After being fully vaccinated you will obtain your COVID-19 certificate  from the MOH website https://portal.health.go.ke.
Kiswahili: Kuchukua aina tofauti za chanjo haipendekezwi. Baada ya kuchanjwa kikamilifu utapata cheti chako cha COVID-19 kutoka kwa tovuti ya MOH https://portal.health.go.ke.

English: Five new Mpox cases detected in Kenya, one patient in isolation
Kiswahili: Visa vitano vipya vya Mpox vyagunduliwa nchini Kenya, mgonjwa mmoja akiwa ametengwa

English: Key causes of TB include undernutrition, HIV, alcohol use disorders, smoking, and diabetes. Get the word out! We can eradicate TB together
Kiswahili: Sababu kuu za Kifua Kikuu ni pamoja na lishe duni, VVU, matatizo ya matumizi ya pombe, uvutaji sigara, na kisukari. Fahamu! Tunaweza kutokomeza Kifua Kikuu pamoja

English: Coughing! Fever! Night sweats! Chest pains! Weight loss! You could have TB. Testing and treatment are free at all public hospitals!Get tested today!
Kiswahili: Kikohozi! Homa! Jasho la usiku! Maumivu ya kifua! Kupunguza uzito! Unaweza kuwa na TB. Upimaji na matibabu ni bure katika hospitali zote za umma! Pima leo!

English: To get cured of TB, you must complete the entire course of treatment as advised by the health worker.
Kiswahili: Ili kupona kifua kikuu, ni lazima ukamilishe matibabu yote kama ilivyoshauriwa na mfanyakazi wa afya.

English: Key points to stop Mpox spread: Avoid close contact with individuals showing symptoms. Do not share personal items like towels, utensils, or clothing. Maintain good hygiene by washing hands frequently.
Kiswahili: Mambo muhimu ya kuzuia kuenea kwa Mpox: Epuka kugusana kwa karibu na watu wanaoonyesha dalili. Usishiriki vitu vya kibinafsi kama vile taulo, vyombo, au nguo. Dumisha usafi mzuri kwa kunawa mikono mara kwa mara.

English: Mpox symptoms include fever, rash, and swollen lymph nodes. Seek medical care immediately if you notice any of these.
Kiswahili: Dalili za Mpox ni pamoja na homa, upele, na uvimbe wa tezi za limfu. Tafuta huduma ya matibabu mara moja ikiwa utagundua yoyote kati ya haya.

English: Mpox outbreak in Mombasa. Two people have died from Monkey Pox disease. Mombasa County has reported 98 Monkey Pox cases. There is a lot of active community transmission
Kiswahili: Mlipuko wa Mpox Mombasa. Watu wawili wamefariki kutokana na ugonjwa wa Tumbili. Kaunti ya Mombasa imeripoti visa 98 vya Tumbili. Kuna maambukizi mengi ya kijamii yanayoendelea

English: Ban on all public gatherings extended to May 29 to curb the spread of Covid-19.
Kiswahili: Marufuku ya mikusanyiko yote ya umma yaongezwa hadi Mei 29 ili kupunguza kuenea kwa Covid-19.

English: Kenya confirms 10 more Covid-19 cases bringing the total number of confirmed infections to 384, nine of the new cases are from Mombasa and one from Nairobi
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa 10 zaidi vya Covid-19 na kufikisha jumla ya maambukizi 384, tisa kati ya visa vipya ni kutoka Mombasa na kimoja kutoka Nairobi.

English: I have invoked the public health act after it was declared a pandemic. Thoroughly wash hands and use alcohol based sanitizers. Keep 1-meter distance from a person who is sneezing or coughing. A person who is coughing or sneezing should stay at home and avoid crowds
Kiswahili: Nimeitisha sheria ya afya ya umma baada ya kutangazwa kuwa janga. Osha mikono vizuri na utumie vitakasa mikono vyenye pombe. Weka umbali wa mita 1 kutoka kwa mtu anayepiga chafya au kukohoa. Mtu anayekohoa au kupiga chafya anapaswa kukaa nyumbani na kuepuka misongamano ya watu.

English: Kenya on high alert over new and deadly mosquito. Anopheles Stephensi causes the deadliest type of Malaria. Health researchers have found the mosquito in Mandera. Mosquito spreads Malaria in both urban and rural areas
Kiswahili: Kenya iko macho kuhusu mbu mpya na hatari. Anopheles Stephensi husababisha aina mbaya zaidi ya Malaria. Watafiti wa afya wamegundua mbu huko Mandera. Mbu hueneza Malaria katika maeneo ya mijini na vijijini

English: Kisumu Governor Nyong'o orders all restaurants shut in the county for failing to adhere to MoH measures against Covid-19.
Kiswahili: Gavana wa Kisumu Nyong'o aamuru migahawa yote ifungwe katika kaunti hiyo kwa kushindwa kufuata sheria za Wizara ya Afya dhidi ya Covid-19.

English: CDC launches a campaign promoting hand hygiene to prevent disease spread.
Kiswahili: CDC yazindua kampeni ya kuhimiza usafi wa mikono ili kuzuia kuenea kwa magonjwa.

English: State launches Kenya National Public Health Institute to bolster disease prevention
Kiswahili: Serikali yazindua Taasisi ya Kitaifa ya Afya ya Umma ya Kenya ili kuimarisha kinga dhidi ya magonjwa

English: If you fee unweel, have a cold, a cough or fever, please call 719 or text *719#
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unajisikia vibaya, una mafua, kikohozi au homa, tafadhali piga simu 719 au tuma ujumbe mfupi *719#

English: During this time, prisoners and remandees will not be presented to court.
Kiswahili: Wakati huu, wafungwa na mahabusu hawatafikishwa mahakamani.

English: Courts will continue to handle certificates of urgency and taking plea for serious cases.
Kiswahili: Mahakama zitaendelea kushughulikia vyeti vya dharura na kupokea malalamiko ya kesi kubwa.

English: Judges in all stations will in the meantime review the deserving cases already identified by Prisons authorities and issue appropriate revision orders in an effort to decongest the prisons. Magistrate Courts will also review bail terms for those in remand.
Kiswahili: Majaji katika vituo vyote kwa wakati huo huo watapitia kesi zinazostahili ambazo tayari zimetambuliwa na mamlaka ya Magereza na kutoa amri zinazofaa za marekebisho katika juhudi za kupunguza msongamano wa magereza. Mahakama za Mahakimu pia zitapitia masharti ya dhamana kwa wale walio mahabusu.

English: The Nyeri ELRC is closed from 24th August to 7th September 2020 due to two confirmed COVID-19 cases, with fumigation and staff self-quarantine underway. No certificates will be processed during this period. The court will reopen for virtual hearings on 21st September, with physical hearings expected to resume under the Presiding Judge’s supervision in early October.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha ELRC cha Nyeri kimefungwa kuanzia tarehe 24 Agosti hadi 7 Septemba 2020 kutokana na visa viwili vilivyothibitishwa vya COVID-19, huku dawa ya kufukiza na kujitenga kwa wafanyakazi kukiwa kunaendelea. Hakuna vyeti vitakavyoshughulikiwa katika kipindi hiki. Mahakama itafunguliwa tena kwa ajili ya vikao vya mtandaoni tarehe 21 Septemba, huku vikao vya kimwili vikitarajiwa kuanza tena chini ya usimamizi wa Jaji Mkuu mapema Oktoba.

English: Kenya reports record daily jump in Covid-19 cases; 123 new infections from 3,077 samples tested.
Kiswahili: Kenya inaripoti ongezeko kubwa la visa vya Covid-19 kila siku; maambukizi mapya 123 kutoka kwa sampuli 3,077 zilizopimwa.

English: Trump’s policy hits Kenyan health initiatives. Policy halts supply of HIV, Malaria and TB drugs. Move also affects medical supplies of newborn babies. Barasa: We’ll look for funding elsewhere if US pulls ou
Kiswahili: Sera ya Trump inaathiri mipango ya afya ya Kenya. Sera inasimamisha usambazaji wa dawa za VVU, Malaria na TB. Hatua hiyo pia inaathiri vifaa vya matibabu vya watoto wachanga. Barasa: Tutatafuta ufadhili kwingineko ikiwa Marekani itaondoa

English: Nigerian company to make HIV, malaria test kits after US funding cut
Kiswahili: Kampuni ya Nigeria kutengeneza vifaa vya kupima VVU na malaria baada ya ufadhili wa Marekani kupunguzwa

English: Global Fund CEO requests Ruto to mobilise funds for HIV, TB & malaria
Kiswahili: Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa Mfuko wa Kimataifa amtaka Ruto kuchangisha fedha kwa ajili ya VVU, Kifua Kikuu na Malaria

English: Kenya faces crisis as Trump’s Executive Order to cut supply of HIV, malaria drugs
Kiswahili: Kenya inakabiliwa na mgogoro huku amri ya Trump ikipunguza usambazaji wa dawa za HIV na malaria

English: KEMRI study shows ivermectin significantly reduces malaria transmission
Kiswahili: Utafiti wa KEMRI unaonyesha ivermectin hupunguza kwa kiasi kikubwa maambukizi ya malaria

English: Health PS distributes mosquito nets in Busia County. Malaria prevalence in Busia stands at 39%. 22 counties targeted in latest campaign
Kiswahili: Katibu Mkuu wa Afya asambaza vyandarua katika Kaunti ya Busia. Kiwango cha malaria huko Busia kimefikia 39%. Kaunti 22 zimelengwa katika kampeni ya hivi karibuni

English: The cost of targeted testing for Covid-19 and government quarantine facilities shall be met by the government effective today. Kenyans should not be afraid to get tested
Kiswahili: Gharama ya upimaji unaolengwa wa Covid-19 na vituo vya karantini vya serikali italipwa na serikali kuanzia leo. Wakenya hawapaswi kuogopa kupimwa.

English: Cessation of movement in Nairobi Metropolitan Area, Mombasa and Mandera extended by a month, bars to remain closed for another 30 days
Kiswahili: Kusitishwa kwa usafiri katika Eneo la Jiji la Nairobi, Mombasa na Mandera kwaongezwa kwa mwezi mmoja, baa zitaendelea kufungwa kwa siku 30 zaidi

English: Today, we have recorded 447 new positive cases out of 3803 samples bringing the total of positive cases in the country to 8,975. Tested samples in the country are now over 200,000
Kiswahili: Leo, tumerekodi visa vipya 447 chanya kati ya sampuli 3803 na kufikisha jumla ya visa chanya nchini kufikia 8,975. Sampuli zilizojaribiwa nchini sasa zina zaidi ya 200,000.

English: Gov’t extends nationwide curfew, ban on public gatherings until May 29
Kiswahili: Serikali yaongeza muda wa kutotoka nje nchini kote, kupiga marufuku mikusanyiko ya umma hadi Mei 29

English: 2,169 people test positive for COVID-19 from 9,428 samples, positivity rate at 23pc; MoH says no death recorded
Kiswahili: Watu 2,169 wamepatikana na virusi vya COVID-19 kutoka kwa sampuli 9,428, kiwango cha walioambukizwa kikiwa asilimia 23; Wizara ya Afya yasema hakuna kifo kilichorekodiwa

English: Magoha says Ksh.1B needed to buy masks for schools
Kiswahili: Magoha anasema Ksh.1B zinahitajika kununua barakoa kwa ajili ya shule

English: There will be no air-lifting people from counties to Nairobi…There will be no capacity to be brought to Nairobi for treatment as Nairobi itself will be already overwhelmed…Where we are heading is unpredictable. It is better to be ready than to be sorry
Kiswahili: Hakutakuwa na watu wanaosafiri kwa ndege kutoka kaunti hadi Nairobi…Hakutakuwa na uwezo wa kuletwa Nairobi kwa matibabu kwani Nairobi yenyewe itakuwa tayari imezidiwa…Tunakoelekea hakutabiriki. Ni bora kuwa tayari kuliko kujuta.

English: Nationwide dusk to dawn curfew extended by 21 days in a bid to tame Covid-19 spread
Kiswahili: Amri ya kutotoka nje ya nchi nzima kuanzia jioni hadi alfajiri yaongezwa kwa siku 21 ili kupunguza kuenea kwa Covid-19

English: 20 doctors from Cuba set to arrive in Nairobi tonight, Health CS Kagwe says they will be stationed at Kenyatta University Hospital for 6 months to help manage the Covid-19 pandemic.
Kiswahili: Madaktari 20 kutoka Cuba wanatarajiwa kuwasili Nairobi usiku wa leo, Waziri wa Afya Kagwe anasema watakuwa katika Hospitali ya Chuo Kikuu cha Kenyatta kwa miezi 6 ili kusaidia kudhibiti janga la Covid-19.

English: Launch of fortified maize, soy blend distributed across primary schools to address undernutrition.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa mchanganyiko wa mahindi na soya ulioimarishwa umesambazwa katika shule za msingi ili kukabiliana na utapiamlo.

English: Launch of voluntary certification recognizing employers who implement nutrition, mental health, and fitness standards.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa cheti cha hiari kinachowatambua waajiri wanaotekeleza viwango vya lishe, afya ya akili, na siha.

English: Introduction of postpartum exercise and nutrition support groups led by physiotherapists and dietitians.
Kiswahili: Utangulizi wa mazoezi ya baada ya kujifungua na vikundi vya usaidizi wa lishe vinavyoongozwa na wataalamu wa tiba ya viungo na wataalamu wa lishe.

English: Announcement encouraging daily consumption of five fruit/veg portions for wellness and disease prevention.
Kiswahili: Tangazo la kuhimiza ulaji wa kila siku wa sehemu tano za matunda/mboga kwa ajili ya ustawi na kinga dhidi ya magonjwa.

English: Pilot providing mobile seed kits and training to women's groups to grow nutritious food in informal settlements.
Kiswahili: Pilot akitoa vifaa vya mbegu vinavyohamishika na mafunzo kwa vikundi vya wanawake ili kukuza chakula chenye lishe katika makazi yasiyo rasmi.

English: The government has imposed a raft of new drastic measures after cases of the new coronavirus in Kenya jumped to 15 in the last 72 hours. The new directives came after eight more people tested positive for COVID-19
Kiswahili: Serikali imeweka hatua kadhaa kali baada ya visa vya virusi vipya vya korona nchini Kenya kupanda hadi 15 katika saa 72 zilizopita. Maagizo hayo mapya yalikuja baada ya watu wengine wanane kupimwa na kupatikana na COVID-19.

English: Kenya confirms three cases of Covid-19 Omicron variant; Health CS Kagwe says it has been detected among travelers who have been quarantined
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa vitatu vya Covid-19 Omicron; Waziri wa Afya Kagwe anasema imegunduliwa miongoni mwa wasafiri ambao wametengwa

English: Kakamega County gov't orders closure of all public mortuaries, Governor Oparanya advises residents to bury their dead immediately.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Kakamega yaamuru kufungwa kwa vyumba vyote vya kuhifadhia maiti vya umma, Gavana Oparanya awashauri wakazi kuzika wafu wao mara moja.

English: Education CS Magoha says colleges and universities to remain closed until January 2021 as they are not Covid-19 compliant
Kiswahili: Waziri wa Elimu Magoha asema vyuo vikuu vitafungwa hadi Januari 2021 kwani havifuati sheria za Covid-19

English: Gov’t orders Mama Mbogas to stop chopping vegetables for customers over COVID-19 fears
Kiswahili: Serikali yamwagiza Mama Mbogas kuacha kukata mboga kwa ajili ya wateja wake kutokana na hofu ya COVID-19

English: For now, open bars and test social distancing. KCPE and KCSE are not a ticket to heaven
Kiswahili: Kwa sasa, fungua baa na jaribu umbali wa kijamii. KCPE na KCSE si tiketi ya kwenda mbinguni

English: Gov't now calls for wearing of masks, vaccination as Kenya faces 6th COVID-19 wave
Kiswahili: Serikali sasa yatoa wito wa kuvaa barakoa na chanjo huku Kenya ikikabiliwa na wimbi la 6 la COVID-19

English:
Mombasa Covid-19 Booths: 
Contactless testing booths to be distributed in 6 constituencies. Booths have zero contact between the medic and patient. Contactless booths allow for safer, faster mass testing. The locally assembled booths are a game changer
Kiswahili:
Vibanda vya Mombasa Covid-19:

Vibanda vya kupima bila kugusa vitasambazwa katika majimbo 6 ya uchaguzi. Vibanda havina mguso wowote kati ya daktari na mgonjwa. Vibanda visivyogusa vinaruhusu upimaji salama na wa haraka wa wingi. Vibanda vilivyokusanyika ndani ya eneo husika vinabadilisha mchezo.

English: Schools to remain open despite a surge in Covid-19 infection rates
Kiswahili: Shule zitabaki wazi licha ya ongezeko la viwango vya maambukizi ya Covid-19

English: Kenya suspends all public gatherings, games, events, and church crusades; inter school games banned after first covid-19 case in Nairobi
Kiswahili: Kenya yasimamisha mikusanyiko yote ya umma, michezo, matukio, na mikutano ya kanisa; michezo ya shule imepigwa marufuku baada ya kisa cha kwanza cha COVID-19 jijini Nairobi

English: Coronavirus: A lockdown in Kenya is an option, but taxes won’t be lifted
Kiswahili: Virusi vya Korona: Kufungiwa nchini Kenya ni chaguo, lakini kodi hazitaondolewa

English: Governor Joho sets up sanitizing booths for pedestrians in Mombasa.
Kiswahili: Gavana Joho aweka vibanda vya usafi kwa watembea kwa miguu Mombasa.

English: Over 80% of patients are asymptomatic and can be treated from home. MoH has completed process of home-based care protocols. I appeal to Kenyans, that when we release the protocols and we see people coming home, there is no need for stigmatization
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya 80% ya wagonjwa hawana dalili na wanaweza kutibiwa nyumbani. Wizara ya Afya imekamilisha mchakato wa itifaki za utunzaji wa nyumbani. Ninawasihi Wakenya, kwamba tunapotoa itifaki hizo na tunaona watu wakirudi nyumbani, hakuna haja ya unyanyapaa.

English: Nairobi, Kajiado, Machakos, Kiambu & Nakuru counties are individually and collectively declared a disease infected area. There shall be a cessation of movement by road, rail, air in to & out of these areas effective midnight
Kiswahili: Kaunti za Nairobi, Kajiado, Machakos, Kiambu na Nakuru zimetangazwa kuwa eneo lililoathiriwa na magonjwa moja moja na kwa pamoja. Kutakuwa na kusimamishwa kwa usafiri kwa barabara, reli, hewa kuingia na kutoka katika maeneo haya kuanzia saa sita usiku.

English: Uganda declares Ebola outbreak after the Health Ministry confirmed a 24-year-old man showed symptoms and later died
Kiswahili: Uganda yatangaza mlipuko wa Ebola baada ya Wizara ya Afya kuthibitisha kuwa mwanaume wa miaka 24 alionyesha dalili na baadaye akafariki

English: Tiaty worst hit with 40% of residents affected. 2 people lost their lives last month due to Malaria. Govt distributing long-lasting treated mosquito nets
Kiswahili: Tiaty imeathiriwa zaidi na 40% ya wakazi walioathiriwa. Watu 2 walipoteza maisha yao mwezi uliopita kutokana na Malaria. Serikali yasambaza vyandarua vilivyotibiwa kwa muda mrefu

English: War on malaria gets a major boost. New drug Argesun deployed in Nyanza. Drug to help ICU patients, children with Malaria
Kiswahili: Vita dhidi ya malaria vyaongezeka sana. Dawa mpya ya Argesun yatumika Nyanza. Dawa ya kuwasaidia wagonjwa wa ICU, watoto wenye Malaria

English: Govt kicks of distribution of mosquito nets. Govt aims at distributing 15.3M treated nets
Kiswahili: Serikali yazindua usambazaji wa vyandarua. Serikali inalenga kusambaza vyandarua milioni 15.3 vilivyotibiwa

English: Health officials deploy drones to combat malaria in Busia County
Kiswahili: Maafisa wa afya watuma ndege zisizo na rubani kupambana na malaria katika Kaunti ya Busia

English: Kenya among 12 African countries to get 18 million doses of malaria vaccine by 2025, WHO says priority will go to countries with the greatest need.
Kiswahili: Kenya miongoni mwa nchi 12 za Afrika kupata dozi milioni 18 za chanjo ya malaria ifikapo mwaka 2025, WHO inasema kipaumbele kitaelekezwa kwa nchi zenye uhitaji mkubwa zaidi.

English: Malaria vaccine advisory: More children in malaria endemic counties to be vaccinated. WHO has given an approval for expanded use of the vaccine. 275,000 children partially jabbed, 45,000 are fully vaccinated. Data shows the number of malaria cases has gone down
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa chanjo ya malaria: Watoto zaidi katika kaunti zilizoathiriwa na malaria watachanjwa. WHO imetoa idhini ya matumizi ya chanjo hiyo kwa upana zaidi. Watoto 275,000 wachapwa sehemu, 45,000 wamechanjwa kikamilifu. Data inaonyesha idadi ya visa vya malaria imepungua

English: We encourage people to seek treatment at health care facilities once they experience any symptoms.  When you seek treatment early, you protect yourself against severe malaria.
Kiswahili: Tunawahimiza watu kutafuta matibabu katika vituo vya afya mara tu wanapopata dalili zozote. Unapotafuta matibabu mapema, unajikinga dhidi ya malaria kali.

English: The Ministry of Health aims to scale the uptake of the malaria vaccine among children aged between 6 months to 14 years.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inalenga kuongeza idadi ya watoto wanaotumia chanjo ya malaria miongoni mwa watoto wenye umri kati ya miezi 6 hadi miaka 14.

English: MoH dispatches 10 Cuban experts to Kakamega, Siaya, Kisumu, Bungoma, Busia, Vihiga, Homa Bay and Migori counties in the fight against malaria with biological methods.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya yatuma wataalamu 10 wa Cuba katika kaunti za Kakamega, Siaya, Kisumu, Bungoma, Busia, Vihiga, Homa Bay na Migori katika mapambano dhidi ya malaria kwa njia za kibiolojia.

English: Happy World Malaria Day! Here’s to raising awareness, protecting our communities, and pushing closer to a world free from malaria.
Kiswahili: Heri ya Siku ya Malaria Duniani! Hapa ni kwa ajili ya kuongeza uelewa, kulinda jamii zetu, na kusukuma karibu na ulimwengu usio na malaria.

English:
Did you know the Kenya Red Cross Society offers free on-call counselling services 24/7? Call us on 1199 and we will be there for you.

Since January-June 2019, our Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Services team attended to 513 calls.
Kiswahili:
Je, unajua kwamba Chama cha Msalaba Mwekundu cha Kenya kinatoa huduma za ushauri nasaha bila malipo masaa 24 kwa siku, siku 7 kwa wiki? Tupigie simu kwa 1199 nasi tutakuwepo kwa ajili yako.

Tangu Januari-Juni 2019, timu yetu ya Huduma za Afya ya Akili na Usaidizi wa Kisaikolojia ilihudhuria simu 513.

English: When we open up and talk about what is affecting our mental health, those issues become bearable. They become less distressing, less overwhelming and less worrying. Reach out to us on 1199 and we will be there for you.
Kiswahili: Tunapofungua na kuzungumzia kinachoathiri afya yetu ya akili, masuala hayo yanakuwa rahisi kuyavumilia. Yanakuwa hayana usumbufu mwingi, hayalemei sana na hayana wasiwasi mwingi. Wasiliana nasi kwa 1199 nasi tutakuwepo kwa ajili yako.

English: Connect with others and be part of positive relationships.Building positive associations with people is good for your mental well-being
Kiswahili: Ungana na wengine na uwe sehemu ya mahusiano chanya. Kujenga mahusiano chanya na watu ni jambo zuri kwa ustawi wako wa akili.

English: Its not unmanly to struggle.Check on the men in your life.
Kiswahili: Si jambo la kiume kujitahidi. Waangalie wanaume katika maisha yako.

English: Definitition of schizophrenia,causes,symptoms,diagnostic tools and treatment.
Kiswahili: Ufafanuzi wa skizofrenia, sababu, dalili, vifaa vya uchunguzi na matibabu.

English: Definitition of bipolar,causes,symptoms,diagnostic tools and treatment.
Kiswahili: Ufafanuzi wa bipolar, sababu, dalili, vifaa vya uchunguzi na matibabu.

English: Indicators of stress:easily irritable,anxious,panic attacks,sleeping problems,social withdrawal,irritability
Kiswahili: Viashiria vya msongo wa mawazo: kukasirika kwa urahisi, wasiwasi, mashambulizi ya hofu, matatizo ya usingizi, kujitenga na watu, kuwashwa

English: Techniques like deep breathing,walking or time outdoors are universal tools for managing daily stressors.
Kiswahili: Mbinu kama vile kupumua kwa kina, kutembea au kutumia muda nje ni zana zinazotumika kwa wote katika kudhibiti msongo wa mawazo wa kila siku.

English: Mental health conditions like depression can lead to physical symptoms such as fatigue and illness, highlighting the strong mind-body connection
Kiswahili: Hali za afya ya akili kama vile mfadhaiko zinaweza kusababisha dalili za kimwili kama vile uchovu na ugonjwa, na hivyo kuonyesha uhusiano mkubwa kati ya akili na mwili.

English: This World Mental Health Day, lets prioritize mental well-being at work! A supportive environment is key to a healthy workplace. Check in on your colleagues today!
Kiswahili: Siku hii ya Afya ya Akili Duniani, hebu tuweke kipaumbele ustawi wa akili kazini! Mazingira yanayounga mkono ni muhimu kwa afya mahali pa kazi. Wasiliana na wenzako leo!

English: Mental well-being is essential for a productive and healthy workplace. Prioritize mental health just as you would physical health.
Kiswahili: Ustawi wa akili ni muhimu kwa mahali pa kazi penye tija na afya. Panga afya ya akili kama vile unavyoweza kuipa kipaumbele afya ya mwili.

English: Talking about mental health breaks the stigma and helps others open up. Lets create a supportive environment for all.
Kiswahili: Kuzungumzia afya ya akili huvunja unyanyapaa na kuwasaidia wengine kufunguka. Tujenge mazingira ya usaidizi kwa wote.

English: Government distributes mosquito nets in malaria fight. Kilifi County is one of the beneficiaries. Nets program was flagged over procurement irregularities. MOH wants to distribute 15M nets in 22 counties
Kiswahili: Serikali yasambaza vyandarua katika mapambano dhidi ya malaria. Kaunti ya Kilifi ni mojawapo ya wanufaika. Programu ya vyandarua iliangaziwa kwa ukiukwaji wa sheria za ununuzi. Wizara ya Afya inataka kusambaza vyandarua milioni 15 katika kaunti 22

English: Kenya confirms 12 more COVID-19 cases bringing total number to 246. Health CS Mutahi Kagwe says 5 of them are hotel workers.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa 12 zaidi vya COVID-19 na kufanya jumla ya idadi kufikia 246. Waziri wa Afya Mutahi Kagwe anasema 5 kati yao ni wafanyakazi wa hoteli.

English: Over the last 24 hours we have tested over 300 Kenyans, out of those 22 have tested positive for covid-19 (13-males, 9-females). 21 out of the 22 cases are people who are currently in quarantine
Kiswahili: Katika saa 24 zilizopita tumewapima Wakenya zaidi ya 300, kati ya hao 22 wamepimwa na kukutwa na virusi vya covid-19 (wanaume 13, wanawake 9). Visa 21 kati ya 22 ni watu ambao kwa sasa wako karantini.

English: Religious leaders under World Council of Churches urge governments and donor countries to increase Global Fund support, to aid sustainable responses to HIV, tuberculosis, and malaria.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa kidini chini ya Baraza la Makanisa Duniani wanahimiza serikali na nchi wafadhili kuongeza usaidizi wa Mfuko wa Dunia, ili kusaidia majibu endelevu kwa VVU, kifua kikuu, na malaria.

English: The US government’s freeze on foreign aid, especially through USAid has caused major disruptions in Kenya’s health sector, particularly in HIV, malaria, and tuberculosis programmes that heavily rely on donor support.
Kiswahili: Kusitishwa kwa misaada ya kigeni na serikali ya Marekani, hasa kupitia USAid, kumesababisha usumbufu mkubwa katika sekta ya afya ya Kenya, hasa katika programu za VVU, malaria, na kifua kikuu ambazo hutegemea sana msaada wa wafadhili.

English: There is no local transmission of malaria in Nairobi. If you have been a full time resident of Nairobi and you get sick with fever the probability that it is malaria is close to zero.
Kiswahili: Hakuna maambukizi ya malaria jijini Nairobi. Kama umekuwa mkazi wa Nairobi kwa muda wote na unaugua homa, uwezekano kwamba ni malaria ni karibu sifuri.

English: Rising temperatures elevate the risk to Nairobi's malaria-free status
Kiswahili: Kuongezeka kwa joto huongeza hatari ya kutokuwepo kwa malaria jijini Nairobi

English: Malaria mortality rate rises to pre-pandemic levels, WHO report shows at least 597,000 people succumbed to the disease last year.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ya WHO inaonyesha kuwa kiwango cha vifo kutokana na malaria kinaongezeka hadi viwango vya kabla ya janga, kwa mujibu wa ripoti hiyo.

English: Mission for Essential Drugs and Supplies suspends orders for USAID-funded essential drugs, move likely to affect the distribution of HIV and malaria drugs
Kiswahili: Shirika la Misheni ya Dawa na Ugavi Muhimu lasimamisha oda za dawa muhimu zinazofadhiliwa na USAID, hatua ambayo inaweza kuathiri usambazaji wa dawa za VVU na malaria

English: Devastating flooding in South Sudan is affecting around 1.4 million people, with more than 379,000 displaced, according to a United Nations update that warned about an upsurge in malaria.
Kiswahili: Mafuriko makubwa nchini Sudan Kusini yanaathiri takriban watu milioni 1.4, huku zaidi ya watu 379,000 wakimbizi, kulingana na taarifa mpya ya Umoja wa Mataifa iliyoonya kuhusu ongezeko la malaria.

English: The Ministry of Health has reassured the public that there will be no shortage of essential drugs, including those for malaria, HIV/AIDS and TB for at least the next one year.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imewahakikishia umma kwamba hakutakuwa na uhaba wa dawa muhimu, ikiwa ni pamoja na zile za malaria, VVU/UKIMWI na Kifua Kikuu kwa angalau mwaka mmoja ujao.

English: Kenya to release genetically modified mosquitoes to fight malaria
Kiswahili: Kenya kutoa mbu waliobadilishwa vinasaba ili kupambana na malaria

English: To lower cases of HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria, and enhance the vaccines and immunisation programme in the country, I have proposed Sh28.7bn for the Global Fund and Sh4.6bn for vaccines and immunisation programmes.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza visa vya VVU/UKIMWI, Kifua Kikuu na Malaria, na kuboresha mpango wa chanjo na chanjo nchini, nimependekeza Sh28.7 bilioni kwa ajili ya Mfuko wa Dunia na Sh4.6 bilioni kwa ajili ya chanjo na programu za chanjo.

English: You are six times more likely to get malaria if you visit Busia, Tana River, Kakamega, Bungoma, Kilifi, Kisumu, Trans Nzoia, Elgeyo Marakwet and Nandi counties, according to the latest data from the Ministry of Health.
Kiswahili: Una uwezekano mara sita zaidi wa kupata malaria ukitembelea kaunti za Busia, Tana River, Kakamega, Bungoma, Kilifi, Kisumu, Trans Nzoia, Elgeyo Marakwet na Nandi, kulingana na data ya hivi karibuni kutoka Wizara ya Afya.

English: Scientists have found that a mosquito species blamed for malaria transmission in eastern and southern Africa has developed resistance to a long-used insecticide in the region.
Kiswahili: Wanasayansi wamegundua kwamba aina ya mbu inayolaumiwa kwa maambukizi ya malaria mashariki na kusini mwa Afrika imekua na upinzani dhidi ya dawa ya kuua wadudu ambayo imekuwa ikitumika kwa muda mrefu katika eneo hilo.

English: Malaria's gendered burden: Recent floods heighten risk for women, girls
Kiswahili: Mzigo wa Malaria kwa jinsia: Mafuriko ya hivi karibuni yaongeza hatari kwa wanawake na wasichana

English: The Health Ministry also said the 2023/2024 mass net distribution campaign was launched in Homa Bay County on November 15, 2023, with 830,862 nets distributed, covering 91 percent of registered households.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya pia ilisema kampeni ya usambazaji wa vyandarua kwa wingi ya 2023/2024 ilizinduliwa katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay mnamo Novemba 15, 2023, huku vyandarua 830,862 vikisambazwa, vikijumuisha asilimia 91 ya kaya zilizosajiliwa.

English: Communities in Baringo fight back against malaria with local solutions and mosquito nets
Kiswahili: Jamii huko Baringo zinapambana na malaria kwa kutumia suluhisho za kienyeji na vyandarua

English: A malaria vaccine tested in Kenya gains WHO prequalification, costing as low as Sh300, becoming the world's second vaccine on the global prequalified list.
Kiswahili: Chanjo ya malaria iliyojaribiwa nchini Kenya yapata sifa ya awali ya WHO, ikigharimu hadi Sh300, na kuwa chanjo ya pili duniani kwenye orodha ya chanjo zilizoidhinishwa awali duniani.

English: Global Fund, through the Kenya Medical Supplies Agency, is distributing mosquito nets in malaria-endemic regions across the country
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Kimataifa, kupitia Shirika la Ugavi wa Dawa la Kenya, unasambaza vyandarua vya mbu katika maeneo yaliyoathiriwa na malaria kote nchini.

English: Malaria mortality has fallen back to levels seen before the Covid-19 crisis, the WHO said Wednesday, but called for faster progress against the disease that killed nearly some 597,000 people last year.
Kiswahili: Vifo vya malaria vimeshuka hadi viwango vilivyoonekana kabla ya janga la Covid-19, WHO ilisema Jumatano, lakini ilitaka maendeleo ya haraka dhidi ya ugonjwa huo ulioua karibu watu 597,000 mwaka jana.

English: 10.9m treated mosquito nets to be distributed across 22 counties in fight against Malaria
Kiswahili: Vyandarua milioni 10.9 vilivyotibiwa vitasambazwa katika kaunti 22 ili kupambana na Malaria

English: Kenya signs six Global Fund grants amounting to Sh59.7 billion to support HIV, TB and malaria interventions; funding to strengthen health and community systems over three years.
Kiswahili: Kenya yasaini ruzuku sita za Mfuko wa Kimataifa zenye thamani ya Sh59.7 bilioni kusaidia uingiliaji kati wa VVU, Kifua Kikuu na malaria; ufadhili wa kuimarisha mifumo ya afya na jamii kwa miaka mitatu.

English: World Malaria Day: Kenya Joins the World in Commemorating Malaria Day.
Kiswahili: Siku ya Malaria Duniani: Kenya Yaungana na Dunia Kuadhimisha Siku ya Malaria.

English: There is a silver lining in the fight against malaria after Kenya was listed alongside 12 other African countries set to receive 18 million doses of the first-ever malaria vaccine in the next two years
Kiswahili: Kuna mwelekeo mzuri katika vita dhidi ya malaria baada ya Kenya kuorodheshwa pamoja na nchi zingine 12 za Afrika zinazotarajiwa kupokea dozi milioni 18 za chanjo ya kwanza kabisa ya malaria katika miaka miwili ijayo.

English: Counties in the northern part of Kenya are recording a high prevalence of malaria, a trend that is worrying scientists, especially with the invasion of a new species of mosquito in the country.
Kiswahili: Kaunti katika sehemu ya kaskazini mwa Kenya zinarekodi kiwango kikubwa cha malaria, hali ambayo inawatia wasiwasi wanasayansi, hasa kutokana na uvamizi wa aina mpya ya mbu nchini.

English: The Ministry of Health is planning to conduct a massive malaria vaccination drive after the WHO warned of a surge in mosquito-borne diseases due to global warming
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inapanga kufanya kampeni kubwa ya chanjo ya malaria baada ya WHO kuonya kuhusu ongezeko la magonjwa yanayoenezwa na mbu kutokana na ongezeko la joto duniani.

English: Fight against malaria faces fresh threat from new deadly mosquito species
Kiswahili: Mapambano dhidi ya malaria yanakabiliwa na tishio jipya kutoka kwa aina mpya za mbu hatari

English: The Kenya Medical Research Institute (Kemri) has dispatched a team of experts to Marsabit to collect samples for tests after nine people died.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Utafiti wa Kimatibabu ya Kenya (Kemri) imetuma timu ya wataalamu kwenda Marsabit kukusanya sampuli kwa ajili ya vipimo baada ya watu tisa kufariki.

English: Kenya receives 10,700 doses of Mpox vaccine to curb disease spread, Health Ministry says; 67 cases confirmed since July 2024.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inasema Kenya yapokea dozi 10,700 za chanjo ya Mpox ili kupunguza kuenea kwa ugonjwa huo; visa 67 vimethibitishwa tangu Julai 2024.

English: Kenya confirms surge in Mpox cases, tally now at 137 with Busia, Mombasa and Nakuru counties leading with highest number of infections.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha kuongezeka kwa visa vya Mpox, ambapo sasa vimefikia 137 huku kaunti za Busia, Mombasa na Nakuru zikiongoza kwa kuwa na idadi kubwa zaidi ya maambukizi.

English: 36 cases of Mpox reported so far in Kenya, two persons admitted and one patient receiving home-based care.
Kiswahili: Visa 36 vya Mpox vimeripotiwa hadi sasa nchini Kenya, watu wawili waliolazwa na mgonjwa mmoja anayepatiwa huduma ya nyumbani.

English: Kenya confirms three new Mpox cases in Busia; Health Ministry warns of a high risk of importing Marburg and Ebola viruses from neighboring Tanzania and Sudan.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa vitatu vipya vya Mpox huko Busia; Wizara ya Afya yaonya kuhusu hatari kubwa ya kuagiza virusi vya Marburg na Ebola kutoka nchi jirani za Tanzania na Sudan.

English: WHO extends Mpox alert, says virus remains public health emergency of international concern, 37,000 cases recorded with 125 deaths since 2024.
Kiswahili: WHO yaongeza tahadhari ya Mpox, yasema virusi hivyo vinasalia kuwa dharura ya afya ya umma inayotia wasiwasi kimataifa, visa 37,000 vimerekodiwa na vifo 125 tangu 2024.

English: The Ministry of Health has confirmed three new Mpox cases in Busia County, bringing the total number to 42 since the outbreak in July 2024.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imethibitisha visa vitatu vipya vya Mpox katika Kaunti ya Busia, na kufikisha jumla ya visa 42 tangu mlipuko wa virusi hivyo Julai 2024.

English: The Ministry of Health has confirmed two new Mpox cases, bringing the total number of infections to 33 since the outbreak began.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya imethibitisha visa viwili vipya vya Mpox, na kufanya jumla ya maambukizi kufikia 33 tangu mlipuko huo uanze.

English: Every day, we are vulnerable to a new outbreak, disease, pandemic or virus. Recent ones include the Marburg virus, Mpox, Ebola, Zika and the nightmarish experience we faced during the Covid-19 pandemic.
Kiswahili: Kila siku, tuko katika hatari ya kupata mlipuko mpya, ugonjwa, janga au virusi. Vipya ni pamoja na virusi vya Marburg, Mpox, Ebola, Zika na tukio baya tulilokabiliana nalo wakati wa janga la Covid-19.

English: Five new Mpox cases confirmed in 12 counties, including Nakuru and Mombasa, raising the total to 28; Health CS Deborah Barasa reports one death and eight under care.
Kiswahili: Visa vitano vipya vya Mpox vimethibitishwa katika kaunti 12, ikiwa ni pamoja na Nakuru na Mombasa, na kufanya jumla ya visa kufikia 28; Waziri wa Afya Deborah Barasa anaripoti kifo kimoja na wanane wakiwa chini ya uangalizi.

English: Kenya confirms two new Mpox cases in Kericho and Taita Taveta counties, raising total to 33; Health Ministry urges schools to enhance safety measures to curb spread.
Kiswahili: Kenya yathibitisha visa viwili vipya vya Mpox katika kaunti za Kericho na Taita Taveta, na kuongeza jumla ya visa hivyo kufikia 33; Wizara ya Afya yahimiza shule kuimarisha hatua za usalama ili kupunguza kuenea kwa virusi hivyo.

English: Kenya's Ministry of Health has urged citizens to strictly adhere to mpox preventive measures as the number of cases continues to rise, with children being particularly vulnerable.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya ya Kenya imewasihi raia kuzingatia kwa makini hatua za kinga za mpox huku idadi ya visa ikiendelea kuongezeka, huku watoto wakiwa katika hatari zaidi.

English: A healthy mind drives workplace success. Prioritizing mental health boosts morale, reduces stress, and improves productivity
Kiswahili: Akili yenye afya huchochea mafanikio mahali pa kazi. Kuweka kipaumbele katika afya ya akili huongeza ari, hupunguza msongo wa mawazo, na huboresha tija

English: Taking care of your mental health is as important as your physical health. A healthy mind leads to a happier, healthier life.
Kiswahili: Kutunza afya yako ya akili ni muhimu kama vile afya yako ya kimwili. Akili yenye afya inaongoza kwenye maisha yenye furaha na afya njema.

English:
What do you do to prioritize mental health?
Talking about it is a great first step.
Kiswahili:
Unafanya nini ili kuweka kipaumbele afya ya akili?
Kuzungumzia kuhusu hilo ni hatua nzuri ya kwanza.

English: Ministry of health has confirmed the first coronavirus case in Kenya. The Kenyan citizen returning from the US to Nairobi via London on 5th March. She was confirmed positive by the national influenza lab. However, the patient is stable
Kiswahili: Wizara ya afya imethibitisha kisa cha kwanza cha virusi vya corona nchini Kenya. Raia huyo wa Kenya anarudi kutoka Marekani hadi Nairobi kupitia London mnamo Machi 5. Alithibitishwa kuwa na virusi hivyo na maabara ya kitaifa ya mafua. Hata hivyo, mgonjwa huyo yuko imara.

English: Gov't calls for wearing of masks as country battles 6th Covid-19 wave
Kiswahili: Serikali yatoa wito wa kuvaa barakoa huku nchi ikipambana na wimbi la 6 la Covid-19

English: All public gatherings meetings, games, events, church crusades have been suspended. Churches can have services as long as they have sanitizer. Schools to remain open but inter school games are cancelled
Kiswahili: Mikutano yote ya hadhara, michezo, matukio, mikutano ya kanisa imesimamishwa. Makanisa yanaweza kuwa na ibada mradi tu yana vitakasa mikono. Shule zitaendelea kufunguliwa lakini michezo kati ya shule imefutwa

English: Mandatory wearing of masks in public and open spaces is now lifted
Kiswahili: Uvaaji wa lazima wa barakoa katika maeneo ya umma na wazi sasa umeondolewa

English:
Your health is our priority! No one should face TB alone. Get tested early and access FREE treatment at your nearest public health facility.
Together, we can end TB in Kenya!
Kiswahili:
Afya yako ndiyo kipaumbele chetu! Hakuna mtu anayepaswa kukabiliana na TB peke yake. Pima mapema na upate matibabu BURE katika kituo cha afya cha umma kilicho karibu nawe.
Kwa pamoja, tunaweza kukomesha TB nchini Kenya!

English:
By recognizing the humanity of individuals with mental illnesses, we can cultivate a more compassionate and understanding society.
If you or someone you know needs psychosocial support, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at our toll-free number, 1199
Kiswahili:
Kwa kutambua ubinadamu wa watu wenye magonjwa ya akili, tunaweza kukuza jamii yenye huruma na uelewa zaidi.

Ikiwa wewe au mtu unayemjua anahitaji usaidizi wa kisaikolojia, tafadhali usisite kuwasiliana nasi kwa nambari yetu ya simu isiyolipishwa, 1199.

English: Educate yourself on mental health issues, so that you can be an ambassador of change, speaking against mental health stigma. Stigma & discrimination are major barriers to accessing mental health services. Choose to live an empowered life, fight the stigma.
Kiswahili: Jielimishe kuhusu masuala ya afya ya akili, ili uweze kuwa balozi wa mabadiliko, ukipinga unyanyapaa wa afya ya akili. Unyanyapaa na ubaguzi ni vikwazo vikubwa vya kupata huduma za afya ya akili. Chagua kuishi maisha yenye uwezo, pambana na unyanyapaa.

English:
Take a journal and note down how your days are and how you're feeling.

Examine your thoughts written over time and soon they become clearer and hidden thoughts and feelings come to the surface to bring a more complete light to the situation.
Kiswahili:
Chukua shajara na uandike jinsi siku zako zilivyo na jinsi unavyohisi.

Chunguza mawazo yako yaliyoandikwa baada ya muda na hivi karibuni yanakuwa wazi zaidi na mawazo na hisia zilizofichwa huja juu ili kuleta mwanga kamili zaidi kwa hali hiyo.

English: There is no health without mental health
Kiswahili: Hakuna afya bila afya ya akili

English: Take a deep breath and relax. Listen to your body. If youre really tired, give yourself time to sleep. Without good sleep, our mental health suffers and our concentration goes downhill. Sometimes the world can wait.
Kiswahili: Vuta pumzi ndefu na upumzike. Sikiliza mwili wako. Ikiwa umechoka sana, jipe ​​muda wa kulala. Bila usingizi mzuri, afya yetu ya akili huharibika na umakini wetu hupungua. Wakati mwingine ulimwengu unaweza kusubiri.

English: Responding to mental health issues for people with disabilities is critical.Do you know someone who would need someone to talk to?SMS support to 20767 to get access to a counsellor.
Kiswahili: Kushughulikia masuala ya afya ya akili kwa watu wenye ulemavu ni muhimu. Je, unamjua mtu ambaye atahitaji mtu wa kuzungumza naye? Tuma ujumbe mfupi wa usaidizi kwa 20767 ili kupata mshauri nasaha.

English: Healthy minds create healthy workplaces. Lets foster environments that prioritize mental health and support employees well-being
Kiswahili: Akili zenye afya huunda sehemu za kazi zenye afya. Tukuze mazingira yanayopa kipaumbele afya ya akili na kusaidia ustawi wa wafanyakazi.

English:
Mental Health Check-Up Time!Mental Health Check-Up Time!
Your mental health is just as important as your physical health. Take a moment to check in with yourself today.
1. How are you feeling emotionally?
2. Are you getting enough rest?
3. Are you eating well?
4. Have you been active lately?
5. Do you need to talk to someone?
Remember, it's okay to seek help if you need it. Your mental well-being matters!
Kiswahili:
Wakati wa Kuchunguza Afya ya Akili! Wakati wa Kuchunguza Afya ya Akili!

Afya yako ya akili ni muhimu kama vile afya yako ya kimwili. Chukua muda kujichunguza leo.

1. Unajisikiaje kihisia?
2. Je, unapata mapumziko ya kutosha?
3. Je, unakula vizuri?
4. Je, umekuwa ukifanya mazoezi hivi karibuni?
5. Je, unahitaji kuzungumza na mtu?
Kumbuka, ni sawa kutafuta msaada ikiwa unahitaji. Ustawi wako wa akili ni muhimu!

English: Safe walking and cycling contributes to healthier lives preventing Non- Communicable diseases such Cancer, diabetes and hypertension and improves ones mental health
Kiswahili: Kutembea salama na kuendesha baiskeli huchangia maisha yenye afya njema kuzuia magonjwa yasiyoambukiza kama vile Saratani, kisukari na shinikizo la damu na kuboresha afya ya akili ya mtu.

English: Alcohol addiction is a severe issue affecting many Kenyans, and the prevalence of illicit brews in the Mt. Kenya region exacerbates this problem. Local health facilities need to be well-equipped to handle mental health issues, which can drive people into alcohol addiction
Kiswahili: Uraibu wa pombe ni tatizo kubwa linalowaathiri Wakenya wengi, na kuenea kwa pombe haramu katika eneo la Mlima Kenya kunazidisha tatizo hili. Vituo vya afya vya eneo hilo vinahitaji kuwa na vifaa vya kutosha kushughulikia masuala ya afya ya akili, ambayo yanaweza kuwasukuma watu katika uraibu wa pombe.

English: Women face unique challenges in addiction treatment such as trauma, mental health, stigma & caregiving roles. Gender responsive care are is not optional, it is essential
Kiswahili: Wanawake wanakabiliwa na changamoto za kipekee katika matibabu ya uraibu kama vile majeraha, afya ya akili, unyanyapaa na majukumu ya ulezi. Huduma inayozingatia jinsia si ya hiari, ni muhimu

English: Schools can be safe havens for mental health education
Kiswahili: Shule zinaweza kuwa mahali salama pa elimu ya afya ya akili

English: Set boundaries and fuel your mind with positive vibes
Kiswahili: Weka mipaka na uiongezee akili yako hisia chanya

English:
This Mens Mental Health Awareness Month, lets break the silence. Society often tells men to "be strong," but real strength lies in acknowledging your struggles and reaching out.

1. Speaking up isnt weaknessits courage.
2. Your feelings are valid.
3.You dont have to face it alone.

Whether its stress, anxiety, depression, or just feeling overwhelmed your mental health matters. Talk to a friend, a counselor, or a support group. Asking for help is a sign of strength, not failure.
 You are human. You deserve support. You are not alone.
Kiswahili:
Mwezi huu wa Uhamasishaji wa Afya ya Akili ya Wanaume, hebu tuvunje ukimya. Mara nyingi jamii huwaambia wanaume "kuwa imara," lakini nguvu halisi iko katika kutambua mapambano yako na kufikia lengo.

1. Kuzungumza si udhaifu - ni ujasiri.

2. Hisia zako ni halali.

3. Huna haja ya kukabiliana nayo peke yako.

Iwe ni msongo wa mawazo, wasiwasi, mfadhaiko, au kuhisi tu kuzidiwa - afya yako ya akili ni muhimu. Zungumza na rafiki, mshauri, au kikundi cha usaidizi. Kuomba msaada ni ishara ya nguvu, si kushindwa.

Wewe ni binadamu. Unastahili usaidizi. Hauko peke yako.

English:
Did you know? Your sleep quality directly affects your mental health!

1.Aim for 7-9 hours of restful sleep each night.
2. Avoid stimulants like caffeine or drugs before bed they disrupt your Zzzs!
Prioritize your rest, recharge your mind, and wake up refreshed!
Kiswahili:
Ulijua? Ubora wa usingizi wako huathiri moja kwa moja afya yako ya akili!

1. Lenga kulala kwa saa 7-9 kila usiku.

2. Epuka vichocheo kama vile kafeini au dawa za kulevya kabla ya kulala - vinavyovuruga hisia zako za Zzz!
Zipe kipaumbele pumziko lako, chaji akili yako, na uamke ukiwa umeburudika!

English: Sports and exercise offer a multifaceted approach to preventing substance use during school breaks. They provide structure, boost mental health, foster social connections and help students build healthy habits that protect against risky behaviors
Kiswahili: Michezo na mazoezi hutoa mbinu mbalimbali za kuzuia matumizi ya dawa za kulevya wakati wa mapumziko ya shule. Hutoa muundo, huimarisha afya ya akili, hukuza miunganisho ya kijamii na huwasaidia wanafunzi kujenga tabia zenye afya zinazowalinda dhidi ya tabia hatarishi.

English: Just like your annual doctors visit, your mind deserves a check-up too
Kiswahili: Kama vile ziara yako ya kila mwaka ya daktari, akili yako pia inastahili kuchunguzwa

English:
Feeling low?  Reaching for alcohol wont lift you up  its a depressant that can make things worse.

Choose real healing: talk to a counselor, join a support group, or reach out for help.
Kiswahili:
Kuhisi umekata tamaa? Kunywa pombe hakutakuinua - ni dawa ya kufadhaisha ambayo inaweza kufanya mambo kuwa mabaya zaidi.

Chagua uponyaji halisi: zungumza na mshauri, jiunge na kikundi cha usaidizi, au wasiliana nasi kwa msaada.

English:
Fuel your body, feed your mind!
What you eat, how you move, and what you avoid directly shapes your mental health.

Choose clean eating, stay active, and say NO to harmful substances.

Your future self will thank you!
Kiswahili:
Tia nguvu mwili wako, lisha akili yako!

Kile unachokula, jinsi unavyotembea, na kile unachoepuka huunda moja kwa moja afya yako ya akili.

Chagua kula safi, endelea kufanya mazoezi, na useme HAPANA kwa vitu vyenye madhara.

Utu wako wa baadaye utakushukuru!

English:
Stressed about money? Dont gamble with your mental health!
When finances feel overwhelming, its tempting to chase "quick fixes" like gambling or substance usebut these only make things worse. Instead, take control by seeking free financial counseling and building healthy money habits.
Your mental health matters. Choose smart solutions over short-term risks.
Kiswahili:
Una msongo wa mawazo kuhusu pesa? Usicheze kamari na afya yako ya akili!
Wakati fedha zinapozidi, inakuvutia kutafuta "suluhisho la haraka" kama vile kamari au matumizi ya dawa za kulevya - lakini hizi hufanya mambo kuwa mabaya zaidi. Badala yake, chukua udhibiti kwa kutafuta ushauri wa kifedha bila malipo na kujenga tabia nzuri za pesa.
Afya yako ya akili ni muhimu. Chagua suluhisho bora badala ya hatari za muda mfupi.

English: Consider therapy or counseling. A mental health professional can provide strategies to cope with stigma and help you develop a positive self-image
Kiswahili: Fikiria tiba au ushauri nasaha. Mtaalamu wa afya ya akili anaweza kutoa mikakati ya kukabiliana na unyanyapaa na kukusaidia kukuza taswira chanya ya wewe mwenyewe

English: Societal pressures and gender-based discrimination can contribute to stress and mental health challenges.
Kiswahili: Shinikizo la kijamii na ubaguzi wa kijinsia vinaweza kuchangia msongo wa mawazo na changamoto za afya ya akili.

English: Understanding mental health issues can empower you to challenge misconceptions. Share accurate information with friends and family to promote awareness and reduce stigma
Kiswahili: Kuelewa masuala ya afya ya akili kunaweza kukuwezesha kupinga dhana potofu. Shiriki taarifa sahihi na marafiki na familia ili kukuza uelewa na kupunguza unyanyapaa.

English: Engage in activities that promote mental health awareness and advocacy. This can help create a sense of belonging and purpose.
Kiswahili: Shiriki katika shughuli zinazokuza ufahamu na utetezi wa afya ya akili. Hii inaweza kusaidia kujenga hisia ya kuwa wa kipekee na kusudi.

English: Communities can come together to support individuals facing both mental health issues and substance use challenges through several strategies
Kiswahili: Jamii zinaweza kukusanyika pamoja ili kuwasaidia watu wanaokabiliwa na matatizo ya afya ya akili na changamoto za matumizi ya dawa za kulevya kupitia mikakati kadhaa.

English: Employers can identify signs of mental health issues in the workplace by observing changes in behavior, such as increased absenteeism, decreased productivity, or withdrawal from colleagues
Kiswahili: Waajiri wanaweza kutambua dalili za matatizo ya afya ya akili mahali pa kazi kwa kuona mabadiliko katika tabia, kama vile kuongezeka kwa kutokuwepo kazini, kupungua kwa tija, au kujiondoa kutoka kwa wafanyakazi wenzao.

English: Ensure there are confidential channels for employees to seek mental health support without fear of retaliation or judgment
Kiswahili: Hakikisha kuna njia za siri kwa wafanyakazi kutafuta msaada wa afya ya akili bila hofu ya kulipiza kisasi au hukumu.

English: Make sure employees are aware of resources available to them, such as Employee Assistance Programs (EAPs), mental health hotlines, or counseling services
Kiswahili: Hakikisha wafanyakazi wanafahamu rasilimali zinazopatikana kwao, kama vile Programu za Usaidizi kwa Wafanyakazi (EAPs), simu za dharura za afya ya akili, au huduma za ushauri nasaha.

English: As Kenya records rising malaria cases due to climate variability, the just ended World Malaria Day serves as a critical reminder of the need to transform public health initiatives to meet these evolving challenges
Kiswahili: Huku Kenya ikirekodi ongezeko la visa vya malaria kutokana na mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa, Siku ya Malaria Duniani iliyomalizika hivi punde inatumika kama ukumbusho muhimu wa hitaji la kubadilisha mipango ya afya ya umma ili kukabiliana na changamoto hizi zinazoendelea.

English: Communities in Baringo fight back against malaria with local solutions and mosquito nets
Kiswahili: Jamii huko Baringo zinapambana na malaria kwa kutumia suluhisho za kienyeji na vyandarua

English: Kenya-tested malaria vaccine gets WHO approval
Kiswahili: Chanjo ya malaria iliyojaribiwa Kenya yaidhinishwa na WHO

English: WHO approves second malaria jab for children, to cost as low as Sh300
Kiswahili: WHO yaidhinisha chanjo ya pili ya malaria kwa watoto, kuwa na gharama ya chini ya Sh300

English: Womens mental health can be influenced by hormonal changes related to the menstrual cycle, pregnancy, and menopause. Substance use can disrupt these hormonal balances, potentially intensifying mental health symptoms
Kiswahili: Afya ya akili ya wanawake inaweza kuathiriwa na mabadiliko ya homoni yanayohusiana na mzunguko wa hedhi, ujauzito, na kukoma hedhi. Matumizi ya dawa za kulevya yanaweza kuvuruga mizania hii ya homoni, na hivyo kuongeza dalili za afya ya akili.

English: Long-term substance use can impair cognitive functions such as memory and decision-making, which can further complicate mental health issues and affect daily functioning
Kiswahili: Matumizi ya dawa za kulevya kwa muda mrefu yanaweza kuathiri utendaji kazi wa utambuzi kama vile kumbukumbu na kufanya maamuzi, ambayo yanaweza kuzidisha matatizo ya afya ya akili na kuathiri utendaji kazi wa kila siku.

English: Goal-setting is subjective. It is important to create goals that make sense for you during your recovery journey. If you need assistance in creating realistic and achievable goals, reach out to your mentor, peer, or another mental health professional for guidance and tips
Kiswahili: Kuweka malengo ni jambo la kibinafsi. Ni muhimu kuunda malengo yanayokufaa wakati wa safari yako ya kupona. Ikiwa unahitaji usaidizi katika kuunda malengo halisi na yanayoweza kufikiwa, wasiliana na mshauri wako, mwenzako, au mtaalamu mwingine wa afya ya akili kwa mwongozo na vidokezo.

English: Look at your family history of mental illness and addiction, several studies have shown that this disease tends to run in the family, but can be prevented. The more you are aware of your biological, environmental and physical risk factors the more likely you are to overcome them
Kiswahili: Angalia historia ya familia yako ya ugonjwa wa akili na uraibu, tafiti kadhaa zimeonyesha kuwa ugonjwa huu huwa unaenea katika familia, lakini unaweza kuzuiwa. Kadiri unavyofahamu zaidi mambo yako ya hatari ya kibiolojia, kimazingira na kimwili, ndivyo unavyozidi kuwa na uwezekano wa kuyashinda.

English: Develop routines for nutrition, exercise, and sleep. This promotes physical and mental health, contributing to a balanced lifestyle.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza utaratibu wa lishe, mazoezi, na usingizi. Hii inakuza afya ya kimwili na kiakili, na kuchangia mtindo wa maisha wenye usawa.

English: Expectant mothers are urged to start antenatal care visits during the first trimester of pregnancy to monitor both mother and babys health. Early check-ups help identify risks and ensure safe delivery.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wajawazito wanahimizwa kuanza ziara za utunzaji wa ujauzito wakati wa miezi mitatu ya kwanza ya ujauzito ili kufuatilia afya ya mama na mtoto. Uchunguzi wa mapema husaidia kutambua hatari na kuhakikisha kujifungua salama.

English: Health centers are offering free iron and folic acid supplements to all pregnant women to prevent anemia and birth defects. Visit your nearest facility today.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya afya vinatoa virutubisho vya chuma na foliki bila malipo kwa wanawake wote wajawazito ili kuzuia upungufu wa damu na kasoro za kuzaliwa. Tembelea kituo kilicho karibu nawe leo.

English: All deliveries should be conducted by skilled birth attendants at health facilities. This ensures safer births and immediate care in case of complications.
Kiswahili: Uzazi wote unapaswa kufanywa na wakunga wenye ujuzi katika vituo vya afya. Hii inahakikisha uzazi salama na huduma ya haraka iwapo kutatokea matatizo.

English: Mothers are advised to exclusively breastfeed their babies for the first six months without giving water or food. Breastmilk provides all the nutrients and protection a baby needs.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wanashauriwa kuwanyonyesha watoto wao pekee kwa miezi sita ya kwanza bila kuwapa maji au chakula. Maziwa ya mama hutoa virutubisho na ulinzi wote ambao mtoto anahitaji.

English: All pregnant women are encouraged to create a birth preparedness plan including identifying a health facility, arranging transport, and saving funds.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wote wajawazito wanahimizwa kuunda mpango wa maandalizi ya kujifungua ikiwa ni pamoja na kutambua kituo cha afya, kupanga usafiri, na kuweka akiba ya fedha.

English: Caregivers should follow the national immunization schedule to protect children against deadly diseases such as measles, polio, and tuberculosis.
Kiswahili: Walezi wanapaswa kufuata ratiba ya kitaifa ya chanjo ili kuwalinda watoto dhidi ya magonjwa hatari kama vile surua, polio, na kifua kikuu.

English: For low birth weight babies, Kangaroo Mother Care  skin-to-skin contact  is recommended to regulate body temperature, improve breastfeeding, and boost survival.
Kiswahili: Kwa watoto waliozaliwa na uzito mdogo, Huduma ya Mama ya Kangaroo - mguso wa ngozi kwa ngozi - unapendekezwa ili kudhibiti joto la mwili, kuboresha unyonyeshaji, na kuongeza maisha.

English: Pregnant women should seek immediate care if they experience severe headaches, swelling, blurred vision, or bleeding. These may be signs of serious complications.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kutafuta huduma ya haraka ikiwa watapata maumivu makali ya kichwa, uvimbe, kutoona vizuri, au kutokwa na damu. Hizi zinaweza kuwa ishara za matatizo makubwa.

English: Mothers and newborns should attend postnatal check-ups within 48 hours after birth to detect any complications and promote healthy recovery.
Kiswahili: Akina mama na watoto wachanga wanapaswa kuhudhuria uchunguzi wa baada ya kujifungua ndani ya saa 48 baada ya kujifungua ili kugundua matatizo yoyote na kukuza afya njema.

English: Pregnant women are encouraged to sleep under insecticide-treated nets and take preventive medication to avoid malaria, which poses risks to both mother and baby.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanahimizwa kulala chini ya vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na dawa za kuua wadudu na kutumia dawa za kuzuia malaria ili kuepuka malaria, ambayo inahatarisha maisha ya mama na mtoto.

English: Men are encouraged to accompany their partners to antenatal clinics and support them during pregnancy and after childbirth. Male involvement improves outcomes.
Kiswahili: Wanaume wanahimizwa kuandamana na wenzi wao kwenye kliniki za ujauzito na kuwasaidia wakati wa ujauzito na baada ya kujifungua. Ushiriki wa wanaume huboresha matokeo.

English: Pregnant women should consume a balanced diet rich in iron, protein, and vitamins to support fetal development and maternal health.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kula lishe bora yenye madini ya chuma, protini, na vitamini ili kusaidia ukuaji wa fetasi na afya ya mama.

English: Children aged 1 to 5 should be dewormed every six months to prevent worm infections that can lead to malnutrition and stunted growth.
Kiswahili: Watoto wenye umri wa miaka 1 hadi 5 wanapaswa kusafishwa minyoo kila baada ya miezi sita ili kuzuia maambukizi ya minyoo ambayo yanaweza kusababisha utapiamlo na ukuaji wa kudumaa.

English: Caregivers are advised to keep the umbilical cord clean and dry. Do not apply substances like ash or herbs as they may cause infections.
Kiswahili: Walezi wanashauriwa kuweka kitovu kikiwa safi na kikavu. Usipake vitu kama majivu au mimea kwani vinaweza kusababisha maambukizi.

English: Communities should educate and support adolescents to avoid early pregnancies through life skills, counseling, and access to reproductive health services.
Kiswahili: Jamii zinapaswa kuwaelimisha na kuwasaidia vijana kuepuka mimba za mapema kupitia ujuzi wa maisha, ushauri nasaha, na upatikanaji wa huduma za afya ya uzazi.

English: Children under five should receive vitamin A drops every six months to boost immunity and reduce child mortality.
Kiswahili: Watoto walio chini ya miaka mitano wanapaswa kupokea matone ya vitamini A kila baada ya miezi sita ili kuongeza kinga na kupunguza vifo vya watoto.

English: Some cultural practices during pregnancy and childbirth may endanger lives. Communities are urged to adopt evidence-based health practices.
Kiswahili: Baadhi ya desturi za kitamaduni wakati wa ujauzito na kujifungua zinaweza kuhatarisha maisha. Jamii zinahimizwa kufuata desturi za kiafya zinazotegemea ushahidi.

English: Caregivers should wash hands with soap before handling babies, after changing diapers, and before feeding to prevent infections.
Kiswahili: Walezi wanapaswa kunawa mikono kwa sabuni kabla ya kuwashughulikia watoto, baada ya kubadilisha nepi, na kabla ya kuwalisha ili kuzuia maambukizi.

English: Fast breathing and chest indrawing in children may signal pneumonia. Seek medical care immediately.
Kiswahili: Kupumua haraka na kuvuta kifua kwa watoto kunaweza kuashiria nimonia. Tafuta huduma ya matibabu mara moja.

English: Parents should register the birth of their child at the nearest civil registration office. A birth certificate secures a childs legal identity and access to services.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanapaswa kusajili kuzaliwa kwa mtoto wao katika ofisi ya usajili wa kiraia iliyo karibu. Cheti cha kuzaliwa kinahakikisha utambulisho wa kisheria wa mtoto na upatikanaji wa huduma.

English: Delivering at home without skilled help puts both mother and baby at risk. Always deliver at a health facility with trained personnel.
Kiswahili: Kujifungua nyumbani bila msaada wa kitaalamu kunamweka mama na mtoto katika hatari. Daima jifungulie katika kituo cha afya chenye wafanyakazi waliofunzwa.

English: Pregnant women living with HIV should attend clinic early to receive antiretroviral therapy and prevent transmission to the baby.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanaoishi na VVU wanapaswa kuhudhuria kliniki mapema ili kupata tiba ya kupunguza makali ya virusi vya ukimwi na kuzuia maambukizi kwa mtoto.

English: Pregnant women in their second trimester should receive deworming medication to improve nutrition and reduce complications.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito katika miezi mitatu yao ya pili ya ujauzito wanapaswa kupokea dawa za minyoo ili kuboresha lishe na kupunguza matatizo.

English: New mothers are encouraged to discuss family planning options with health providers to allow proper spacing of pregnancies and ensure maternal recovery.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wapya wanahimizwa kujadili chaguzi za uzazi wa mpango na watoa huduma za afya ili kuruhusu nafasi nzuri ya ujauzito na kuhakikisha mama anaendelea kupona.

English: At six months, introduce soft, nutrient-rich foods while continuing breastfeeding. Avoid sugary snacks and ensure hygiene during feeding.
Kiswahili: Katika miezi sita, mtangulie vyakula laini na vyenye virutubisho vingi huku ukiendelea kunyonyesha. Epuka vitafunio vyenye sukari na hakikisha usafi wakati wa kunyonyesha.

English: Adolescent mothers need extra emotional, nutritional, and medical support. Communities are urged to reduce stigma and promote inclusive care.
Kiswahili: Akina mama vijana wanahitaji msaada wa ziada wa kihisia, lishe, na matibabu. Jamii zinahimizwa kupunguza unyanyapaa na kukuza utunzaji jumuishi.

English: Pregnant women should receive tetanus toxoid vaccination to protect themselves and their babies from neonatal tetanus.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kupata chanjo ya pepopunda ili kujikinga na watoto wao kutokana na pepopunda ya watoto wachanga.

English: New mothers experiencing sadness, withdrawal, or hopelessness should seek mental health support. Postpartum depression is treatable.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wapya wanaopitia huzuni, kujitenga, au kukata tamaa wanapaswa kutafuta msaada wa afya ya akili. Mfadhaiko baada ya kujifungua unaweza kutibiwa.

English: Regular weight checks at clinics help detect growth issues early. Caregivers are encouraged to attend monthly child welfare clinics.
Kiswahili: Kupima uzito mara kwa mara katika kliniki husaidia kugundua matatizo ya ukuaji mapema. Walezi wanahimizwa kuhudhuria kliniki za ustawi wa watoto kila mwezi.

English: A toll-free maternal health helpline is available for advice and emergency referrals. Dial 1195 anytime.
Kiswahili: Simu ya usaidizi wa afya ya mama bila malipo inapatikana kwa ushauri na rufaa za dharura. Piga 1195 wakati wowote.

English: Families are encouraged to identify emergency transport options in advance, in case labor begins unexpectedly. Delays in reaching the hospital can lead to complications.
Kiswahili: Familia zinahimizwa kutambua njia za usafiri wa dharura mapema, iwapo uchungu wa kujifungua utaanza bila kutarajia. Kuchelewa kufika hospitalini kunaweza kusababisha matatizo.

English: Mothers who express breast milk should ensure clean containers, proper refrigeration, and correct warming procedures to prevent contamination.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wanaokamua maziwa ya mama wanapaswa kuhakikisha vyombo vinasafishwa, vinahifadhiwa vizuri kwenye jokofu, na taratibu sahihi za kupasha joto ili kuzuia uchafuzi.

English: Community maternal support groups provide peer education, emotional support, and help connect women to health services during pregnancy and postpartum.
Kiswahili: Vikundi vya usaidizi wa akina mama katika jamii hutoa elimu ya rika, usaidizi wa kihisia, na husaidia kuwaunganisha wanawake na huduma za afya wakati wa ujauzito na baada ya kujifungua.

English: A high fever in a child could be a sign of malaria or infection. Visit the nearest clinic without delay to prevent complications.
Kiswahili: Homa kali kwa mtoto inaweza kuwa ishara ya malaria au maambukizi. Tembelea kliniki iliyo karibu bila kuchelewa ili kuzuia matatizo.

English: Skin-to-skin care helps stabilize small or preterm babies and promotes weight gain and bonding.
Kiswahili: Utunzaji wa ngozi kwa ngozi husaidia kuimarisha watoto wadogo au waliozaliwa kabla ya wakati na kukuza ongezeko la uzito na mshikamano.

English: Postpartum women should take deworming medication to improve nutrition and milk quality.
Kiswahili: Wanawake baada ya kujifungua wanapaswa kutumia dawa za minyoo ili kuboresha lishe na ubora wa maziwa.

English: Babies under six months get all the hydration they need from breast milk. Giving water increases infection risk.
Kiswahili: Watoto walio chini ya miezi sita hupata maji yote wanayohitaji kutoka kwa maziwa ya mama. Kumpa mtoto maji huongeza hatari ya kuambukizwa.

English: Sleeping under insecticide-treated nets protects expectant mothers and their unborn babies from malaria.
Kiswahili: Kulala chini ya vyandarua vilivyotibiwa dawa za kuua wadudu huwalinda akina mama wajawazito na watoto wao ambao hawajazaliwa kutokana na malaria.

English: Swollen feet, thin limbs, or constant fatigue in a child may be signs of malnutrition. Seek help immediately.
Kiswahili: Miguu iliyovimba, miguu myembamba, au uchovu wa kila mara kwa mtoto inaweza kuwa dalili za utapiamlo. Tafuta msaada mara moja.

English: Do not apply substances to the cord. Keep it dry and clean until it falls off naturally.
Kiswahili: Usipake vitu kwenye kamba. Iweke kavu na safi hadi ianguke kiasili.

English: Severe headaches, swelling, or bleeding during pregnancy require immediate medical attention.
Kiswahili: Maumivu makali ya kichwa, uvimbe, au kutokwa na damu wakati wa ujauzito kunahitaji matibabu ya haraka.

English: Always keep your childs health card and birth certificate safe for school, healthcare, and legal needs.
Kiswahili: Daima weka kadi ya afya ya mtoto wako na cheti cha kuzaliwa salama kwa mahitaji ya shule, huduma ya afya, na kisheria.

English: New mothers may experience sadness or anxiety. Counseling and support groups can help.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wapya wanaweza kupata huzuni au wasiwasi. Ushauri nasaha na vikundi vya usaidizi vinaweza kusaidia.

English: If your child is not sitting, crawling, or speaking by the expected age, visit a pediatric clinic for evaluation
Kiswahili: Ikiwa mtoto wako hajakaa, hajatambaa, au hajazungumza kwa umri unaotarajiwa, tembelea kliniki ya watoto kwa ajili ya tathmini.

English: Taking over-the-counter or herbal medicines without a prescription during pregnancy can be dangerous.
Kiswahili: Kuchukua dawa za mitishamba au zilizoagizwa bila agizo la daktari wakati wa ujauzito kunaweza kuwa hatari.

English: Teen mothers should be encouraged and supported to continue their education after childbirth.
Kiswahili: Akina mama vijana wanapaswa kutiwa moyo na kuungwa mkono ili kuendelea na masomo yao baada ya kujifungua.

English: Expectant mothers are strongly advised to avoid all alcohol. Drinking during pregnancy can lead to fetal alcohol syndrome and developmental delays.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wajawazito wanashauriwa sana kuepuka pombe kabisa. Kunywa pombe wakati wa ujauzito kunaweza kusababisha ugonjwa wa pombe ya fetasi na kuchelewa kwa ukuaji.

English: Hormonal changes during pregnancy can affect oral health. Visit a dentist for check-ups and maintain oral hygiene.
Kiswahili: Mabadiliko ya homoni wakati wa ujauzito yanaweza kuathiri afya ya kinywa. Mtembelee daktari wa meno kwa uchunguzi na udumishe usafi wa kinywa.

English: Yellowing of the skin and eyes in newborns should be checked by a health worker. Severe jaundice can affect brain development.
Kiswahili: Kuwa na rangi ya njano kwenye ngozi na macho kwa watoto wachanga kunapaswa kuchunguzwa na mfanyakazi wa afya. Homa kali ya manjano inaweza kuathiri ukuaji wa ubongo.

English: Health facilities offer family planning counseling to couples and individuals to support informed decisions about spacing and limiting births.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya afya hutoa ushauri nasaha wa uzazi wa mpango kwa wanandoa na watu binafsi ili kusaidia maamuzi sahihi kuhusu nafasi na kupunguza uzazi.

English: Caregivers should change diapers frequently and clean the babys skin gently to avoid rashes and infections.
Kiswahili: Walezi wanapaswa kubadilisha nepi mara kwa mara na kusafisha ngozi ya mtoto kwa upole ili kuepuka vipele na maambukizi.

English: Pregnant women should eat small meals several times a day to manage nausea and maintain energy levels.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kula milo midogo mara kadhaa kwa siku ili kudhibiti kichefuchefu na kudumisha viwango vya nishati.

English: Using simple hand signs helps babies express needs early, reducing frustration for both caregiver and child.
Kiswahili: Kutumia ishara rahisi za mikono huwasaidia watoto kueleza mahitaji yao mapema, na hivyo kupunguza kuchanganyikiwa kwa mlezi na mtoto.

English: Fathers are encouraged to be active in bathing, changing, and comforting their newborns to promote bonding and family well-being.
Kiswahili: Akina baba wanahimizwa kuwa hai katika kuwaogesha, kuwabadilisha, na kuwafariji watoto wao wachanga ili kukuza uhusiano na ustawi wa familia.

English: Mothers are urged to visit immunization booths during market days for convenient access to childhood vaccines.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wanahimizwa kutembelea vibanda vya chanjo wakati wa siku za soko ili kupata chanjo za watoto kwa urahisi.

English: Children struggling to speak or recognize sounds may have learning difficulties. Seek assessment from child specialists early.
Kiswahili: Watoto wanaojitahidi kuzungumza au kutambua sauti wanaweza kuwa na matatizo ya kujifunza. Tafuta tathmini kutoka kwa wataalamu wa watoto mapema.

English: New mothers can begin light exercises after consulting their doctor to improve recovery and mental health.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wapya wanaweza kuanza mazoezi mepesi baada ya kushauriana na daktari wao ili kuboresha kupona na afya ya akili.

English: Babies should never be exposed to cigarette smoke. Secondhand smoke increases the risk of asthma and sudden infant death syndrome.
Kiswahili: Watoto wachanga hawapaswi kamwe kuathiriwa na moshi wa sigara. Moshi wa sigara unaotoka kwa mtu mwingine huongeza hatari ya pumu na ugonjwa wa kifo cha ghafla cha watoto wachanga.

English: Handwashing with soap before feeding and after diaper changes prevents infections in children and mothers.
Kiswahili: Kunawa mikono kwa sabuni kabla ya kulisha na baada ya kubadilisha nepi huzuia maambukizi kwa watoto na akina mama.

English: Keeping newborns in skin-to-skin contact with mothers helps regulate temperature, heartbeat, and supports immune development.
Kiswahili: Kuwaweka watoto wachanga katika mgusano wa ngozi na mama husaidia kudhibiti halijoto, mapigo ya moyo, na kusaidia ukuaji wa kinga mwilini.

English: Deworming children every six months improves their growth, energy levels, and school performance.
Kiswahili: Kutoa dawa za minyoo kwa watoto kila baada ya miezi sita huboresha ukuaji wao, viwango vya nishati, na utendaji wao shuleni.

English: Pregnant women should start antenatal care in the first trimester to detect and manage any health concerns early.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito wanapaswa kuanza huduma ya ujauzito katika trimester ya kwanza ili kugundua na kudhibiti matatizo yoyote ya kiafya mapema.

English: Help children understand the arrival of a new sibling to reduce jealousy and promote bonding.
Kiswahili: Wasaidie watoto kuelewa ujio wa ndugu mpya ili kupunguza wivu na kukuza uhusiano wa karibu.

English: Mobile health clinics bring vital prenatal and postnatal services closer to remote communities.
Kiswahili: Kliniki za afya zinazohamishika huleta huduma muhimu za ujauzito na baada ya kujifungua karibu na jamii za mbali.

English: Working mothers can express and store breast milk to ensure continued breastfeeding support while away.
Kiswahili: Akina mama wanaofanya kazi wanaweza kukamua na kuhifadhi maziwa ya mama ili kuhakikisha unyonyeshaji unaoendelea wakiwa mbali.

English: Babies born before 37 weeks require warmth, feeding support, and regular health checkups for proper development.
Kiswahili: Watoto waliozaliwa kabla ya wiki 37 wanahitaji kupashwa joto, usaidizi wa kulisha, na uchunguzi wa afya mara kwa mara kwa ajili ya ukuaji sahihi.

English: Men,its okay to talk about your mental health.Speaking up is a sign of strength.
Kiswahili: Wanaume, ni sawa kuzungumzia afya yako ya akili. Kuzungumza ni ishara ya nguvu.

English: Taking time for yourself is not a luxury, it's a necessity. Remember to prioritize your mental, emotional, and physical health.
